allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
chore: add pre-commit hooks configuration

Add .pre-commit-config.yaml with automated code quality checks:

Formatters & Linters:
- black: Code formatting \(line length 100, Python 3.11\)
- ruff: Fast linting with auto-fix
- mypy: Static type checking in strict mode

Pre-commit Hooks:
- trailing-whitespace: Remove trailing whitespace
- end-of-file-fixer: Ensure files end with newline
- check-yaml: Validate YAML files
- check-added-large-files: Prevent large file commits \(>1MB\)
- check-merge-conflict: Detect merge conflict markers
- check-toml: Validate TOML files
- detect-private-key: Prevent committing private keys

Setup:
  pip install pre-commit
  pre-commit install

Run manually:
  pre-commit run --all-files

This ensures code quality and security before each commit.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
docs: create comprehensive hackathon submission document

- Add properly formatted authors list \(5 team members\)
- Include UER abstract with key capabilities and hackathon context
- Write complete Introduction section \(challenge, limitations, solution, research questions\)
- Document Methods: architecture, tools, testing methodology with code examples
- Present Results: multi-model comparison, sycophancy/sandbagging detection, token efficiency
- Provide Discussion: key findings, limitations, future work, threat model
- Add References section organized by hackathon tracks
- Include Security Considerations appendix with risks and mitigations
- Add team contributions and reproducibility information

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
